The '''Aargau Investment Trust''' was a financial trust operating during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It had a branch office on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Kenobi" />
